vocab.meaning_vi: hạn chốt dữ liệu tính lương

listening.title: A question about this month's salary

lines.speaker: Hai (Sales Staff)
lines.text: Hi Ngoc, do you have a minute? I have a question about my salary this month.

lines.speaker: Ngoc (Payroll Accountant)
lines.text: Sure, Hai. What seems to be the problem?

lines.speaker: Hai (Sales Staff)
lines.text: I can't see my commission for the big contract, and my overtime is missing too.

lines.speaker: Ngoc (Payroll Accountant)
lines.text: Let me check. Both were approved on the 22nd, after the payroll cut-off on the 20th.

lines.speaker: Hai (Sales Staff)
lines.text: Oh, so I'll get them next month?

lines.speaker: Ngoc (Payroll Accountant)
lines.text: Yes, in the next payroll run. The overtime will be at the holiday overtime rate, too.

lines.speaker: Hai (Sales Staff)
lines.text: Good. Also, my raise started in August. Will I get that money back?

lines.speaker: Ngoc (Payroll Accountant)
lines.text: Yes, you'll get retroactive pay for August and September next month.

lines.speaker: Hai (Sales Staff)
lines.text: Great, thanks. One more thing: is it possible to get a small salary advance?

lines.speaker: Ngoc (Payroll Accountant)
lines.text: Yes, up to half your salary. Just ask your manager to approve the request first.
